dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: It's great, but we got lost on our first day!
dialogue.reading: ɪts ˈɡreɪt, bʌt wiː ˈɡɑːt ˈlɔːst ɑːn aʊər ˈfɜːrst ˈdeɪ!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.reading: ˈriːli? ˈdɪdənt juː ˈjuːz ˌdʒiː piː ˈɛs?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Yes, but the GPS on my phone didn't work. We walked in the wrong direction for an hour.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, bʌt ðə ˌdʒiː piː ˈɛs ɑːn maɪ ˈfoʊn ˈdɪdənt ˈwɜːrk. wiː ˈwɔːkt ɪn ðə ˈrɔːŋ dəˈrɛkʃən fər ən ˈaʊər.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Oh no! How did you get back to your hotel?
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ ˈnoʊ! ˈhaʊ dɪd juː ˈɡɛt ˈbæk tə jʊr hoʊˈtɛl?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: We took a taxi, but we got stuck in traffic. It was rush hour.
dialogue.reading: wiː ˈtʊk ə ˈtæksi, bʌt wiː ˈɡɑːt ˈstʌk ɪn ˈtræfɪk. ɪt wʌz ˈrʌʃ ˌaʊər.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Bangkok is the same at rush hour!
dialogue.reading: ˈbæŋkɑːk ɪz ðə ˈseɪm ət ˈrʌʃ ˌaʊər!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: We got very hungry and tired in the taxi. We got back to the hotel at nine!
dialogue.reading: wiː ˈɡɑːt ˈvɛri ˈhʌŋɡri ənd ˈtaɪərd ɪn ðə ˈtæksi. wiː ˈɡɑːt ˈbæk tə ðə hoʊˈtɛl ət ˈnaɪn!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Yes! Today we're going on a tour with a guide. We won't get lost again!
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs! təˈdeɪ wɪr ˈɡoʊɪŋ ɑːn ə ˈtʊr wɪð ə ˈɡaɪd. wiː ˈwoʊnt ˈɡɛt ˈlɔːst əˈɡɛn!
